title: Docling extraction deployment
scope: Start optional authenticated Docling service with bounded document sizes and local model artifacts

acceptance.text: Start optional authenticated Docling service with bounded document sizes and local model artifacts
Extract a synthetic scanned/table document; verify unauthorized request rejection and page provenance
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Extract a synthetic scanned/table document; verify unauthorized request rejection and page provenance

evidence.text: Started docling-serve-cpu v1.38.2 (digest-pinned; equals locked source 9c058db) via python3 scripts/docling_dev.py up: X-Api-Key required (generated DOCLING_API_KEY in ignored .env), loopback 127.0.0.1:55001, MAX_FILE_SIZE 25 MiB (= contract), MAX_NUM_PAGES 50, MAX_DOCUMENT_TIMEOUT 300 s, remote services/plugins/custom model configs disabled, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Local model artifacts: image's default set (871 MB: layout heron, TableFormer, figure classifier, EasyOCR, RapidOCR); every conversion logged 'No model weights will be downloaded at runtime'.

Observed via python3 scripts/docling_dev.py smoke (twice): two-page image-only synthetic invoice converted (HTTP 200, status success, ~10-12 s, 2 pages); OCR found invoice number in text with prov.page_no 1; one table with prov.page_no 2, bboxes present, 4x3 cells exact (Item/Qty/Amount LSL, Consulting services/1/3000.00, Freight/2/450.00, Total/3450.00). Unauthorized: no key 401, wrong key 401. Size bound: 25 MiB+1 file -> status failure, error category policy, no content. tests/tooling/test_docling_dev.py 4 tests OK; dev.py check, quality.py and docker compose config passed; .env secrets not in staged diff.

Tests and evidence recorded for criteria 1-2; task.py finish refreshed from origin/main, reran dev.py check and quality.py (Node 24.20.0), pushed task/TAX-028, opened human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/101 and synced issue #29 to IN_REVIEW. Not merged by the agent.
